member.name: LineStatusIconMarginBase.Class
member.summary: Provides the shared marker plumbing for line-status margins that draw a replaceable icon on every visible marked line and run a click action for it.

member.name: LineStatusIconMarginBase.Remarks
member.para: The margin draws with , scaled with the margin's font size and centered in the reserved width. The geometry is authored for the design font size and repositioned from its own bounds, so any authored origin works.

A left press runs for the pointer position, which resolves the visual line under it and invokes . A subclass that performed an action returns , which marks the press handled; a press that resolves to no line stays untouched.

The properties are registered here so sibling margins share one implementation. A derived margin overrides the property's default value with its own default and documents that default on its type. The reserved width and the marker scale are inherited from and follow the margin's font size.

member.name: IconBrushProperty
member.remarks: The base registration defaults to a neutral gray.

member.name: IconGeometryProperty
member.remarks: The base registration defaults to an empty geometry, which draws nothing.

member.name: IconBrush
member.summary: The brush that draws the marker icon.
member.remarks: Hosts should set the brush to their theme's marker color.

member.name: IconGeometry
member.summary: The geometry that draws the marker icon.

member.name: TryHandleClickAt
member.summary: Runs the click path for a position in the margin's coordinate space without a routed event.
member.param: The position in the margin's coordinate space.
member.returns: when a visual line was found at the position and reported the click handled; otherwise, .
member.remarks: The press handler calls this member with the event's position, so a host that routes pointer input itself runs the same path. The call does not check IsEnabled: a disabled margin receives no press, but a direct call still runs the click action.

member.name: MarkerLayout
member.summary: The parts of a marker transform that do not vary from marked line to marked line.
member.remarks: HasIcon reports whether the icon geometry has bounds and therefore paints; IconHeight is the scaled icon height, which each marker uses to center its icon in the line box, clamped into the first text line of a word-wrapped line; and BaseMatrix carries the scale and horizontal placement every marker shares, so a marker adds its icon's vertical offset to the matrix's offset-Y to place itself.

member.name: OnIconClicked

The click position in the margin's coordinate space.
member.returns: when the press was handled; otherwise, .
member.remarks: The call runs for a left press, or a call, whose position resolved to a visual line; returning marks the press handled. The base implementation does nothing.
